title: Sidney Bechet in the District and Robinson's youth
summary: Bechet worked in the District; Robinson, too young then, describes police chasing youths away and the women there.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: I mean, Sidney Bechet was working, working in the district and working on the Marine, uh, I mean, working on the Marine, the Marine, the Marine Benful, I think he was working, Sidney Bechet.
He was working there, I think.
You know the name of the place? I'm trying to tell you something.

No, I never knew the name of the place. Mm-hmm. He said, at the time then, the district was, uh, you know, no young fellas go through that much. And I was, I was young then, you see, you know. I just, once I could come through there, like a, I'd come from the St. Catharines Hall and, we'd come home, you know, and I'd be with some fellas old than what I was, you see. You know, that person, like, you're the music, you know, and I know who you play, but I couldn't go around and go in there places then. Mm-hmm. I couldn't go in there places. I was 21 years old, I couldn't go in there places then. Mm-hmm. Polis would, would chase you, but they wouldn't put you in jail, but they'd chase you, you know what I'm saying? They'd chase you up, and they'd run across the base. They wouldn't put you in jail, because you know you're comfortable, but they'd make you keep a walking, because the women's are always in the street, the different kind of stuff like that. The other words, like to me, the women, they had more, they had more shame of themselves than what the women's got now, I think. stuff like stuff like stuff like stuff stuff like stuff like stuff stuff like stuff like stuff stuff like stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff like stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff

I mean, it was fast women, it was fast women, but when they go home and dress themselves, when they come in the streets, you couldn't tell who them people was. They were people altogether. That's true. Fine looking women, but you couldn't tell who they was. You couldn't have them in the kind of way, neither.
